title: I finally exited to the correct parking lot.
content: I think I "advanced a level" last night. Long story short, I finally exited through the correct parking lot, and found my car. However, there were obstacles, namely family members, preventing me from leaving quickly. The dream started in the auditorium. Everyone was ready to perform some college assigment/show and I had a part with two lines. I had missed All the rehearsals due to illness unnamed. When we went live, I did not know the routine, this ruining the show, and pissing everyone off who was involved. Forward to me gathering my things from my college dorm and trying to leave. I had an id card, but was denied breakfast from the campus eatery due to already being de-registered due to my horrid performance. I went STRAIGHT to the exit and found my car. My family, embarrassed by me, tried to sabotage me from leaving. They lined up large moving trucks and shipping trucks to make my exit even slower. Reason for the title, it's the ONLY time I had no trouble FINDING my car. I am rambling like a mad woman. I should probably stop now.
